output.memo: The suggested price is 780.91 EUR per piece, which gives a 20.7 percent margin on the cost estimate. This follows won quotation FS-25-0117 for Ebrecht Fabrication at 763.64 EUR per piece and a 21.4 percent margin, as well as won quotation Q-G0200 at a 20.7 percent margin. The range from won references sits between 751.53 and 790.88 EUR per piece, leaving solid room to negotiate down if needed.

The suggested price is 1430.50 EUR per piece, an 18.2 percent margin on the cost estimate. Torvane Structures won quotation Q-G0091 at an 18.2 percent margin and quotation Q-G0127 at a 17.7 percent margin. The range from won references spans 1421.81 to 1437.53 EUR per piece, so there is little room to negotiate.

The suggested price is 819.43 EUR per piece, which gives a 22.7 percent margin on the cost estimate. Baltic Frames accepted Q-G0211 with a 23.1 percent margin, while Torvane Structures accepted Q-G0236 at a 24.9 percent margin. The range from won references sits between 779.57 and 842.89 EUR per piece, leaving solid room to negotiate down if challenged.

The suggested price is 799.32 EUR per piece, which gives a 19.7 percent margin on the cost estimate. Past won quotes for Ebrecht Fabrication support this, including Q-G0204 with an 18.6 percent margin and Q-G0200 with a 20.7 percent margin. The range from won references of 779.43 to 817.11 EUR per piece gives room to negotiate down if needed.

The suggested price is 1438.79 EUR per piece, which gives an 18.2 percent margin on the cost estimate. Torvane Structures won quotation Q-G0127 at a 17.7 percent margin and Q-G0011 at an 18.6 percent margin. With the range from won references spanning 1430.92 to 1446.74 EUR per piece, there is narrow room to negotiate.

The suggested price is 805.96 EUR per piece, which gives an 18.3 percent margin on the cost estimate. This is justified by WON reference Q-G0204 for Ebrecht Fabrication at an 18.6 percent margin. With the range from won references spanning 798.63 to 829.85 EUR per piece, you have room to negotiate down to that lower bound.
